summary: Navigation Fork P0 search bug is FIXED. Verified the new entity-based universal search end-to-end: 17/17 backend pytest cases pass (top-result correctness for montreal/habs/canadiens/wild/dallas/stars/kaprizov/kamloops/blazers/whl/golden gophers/minnesota gophers, minnesota surfacing Wild, WHL league hub, warm perf <1.5s) plus regression for /api/leagues, /api/nhl/standings, /api/nhl/team/MIN. Frontend main-search screen renders Montréal Canadiens (NHL), Kamloops Blazers (WHL), Minnesota Golden Gophers (NCAA), and a WHL 'League hub' card; each result routes to /team/MTL, /team/KAM?league=whl, /league/whl respectively. Onboarding search step now returns 'Montréal Canadiens' for 'Montreal' — the previous 'Not connected yet' empty state no longer appears, and the result can be added via result-team-MTL. Search responses are near-instant (single warm calls consistently <1.5s; frontend feels snappy at 120ms debounce).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Emitted repeatedly across screens on RN web. Not blocking, but should be migrated to boxShadow per RN 0.76+ guidance.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow to silence RN web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: entity_index.py is clean: accent-fold via NFKD, alias maps for NHL/NCAA short names, league entities emitted with league-hub id=code, LEAGUE_RANK breaks ties so senior league (NHL) wins ambiguous city queries like 'minnesota' — matches spec. 30-min in-memory cache + provider-level team_entities caching keeps the hot path zero-network for known entities.

registry.search_all now delegates to entity_index.search_entities and swallows exceptions returning [] — good defensive default, but a hard provider outage would silently produce empty results. Consider surfacing a warning header when the entity index is empty so ops can spot a build failure.
search.tsx routes league type to /league/{code} correctly and uses stable team_abbr/player_id for team/player routing. 120ms debounce + runId guard against out-of-order responses is correct.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Entity index is warm-cached for 30 min. To force a fresh build hit /api/search with any query after a backend restart. NCAA team list is a static seed (Highlightly is empty in offseason); MINN is the abbr used for Minnesota Golden Gophers. Frontend main search is at /search; onboarding at /onboarding?reset=1 -> welcome-go -> region-* -> interest-* + interests-next -> onboard-search + result-team-*.
